predecessors.name: Bukharan People's Soviet Republic
predecessors.text: the Tajik ASSR: Tajikistan without the Khujand region

predecessors.name: Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic
predecessors.text: the Khujand region, Leninabad Oblast (today's Sughd)

ledger.x: 1924, 14 October: the Tajik ASSR "had been created on 14 October 1924 as a part of the predominantly Turkic Uzbek SSR".
1924, 14 October: the Tajik ASSR "had been created on 14 October 1924 as a part of the predominantly Turkic Uzbek SSR"; the page names no districts.

1929, 15 October: "a region around Khujand" splits off from the Uzbek SSR with the Tajik ASSR to form the Tajik SSR; the Tajik page dates the addition of Sughd to the republic's creation in December 1929.
1929, December: "In December 1929, Tajik ASSR was detached from the Uzbek SSR and given full status" (the Uzbek page dates the split to 15 October 1929).
1929, 5 December: "Union republic proclaimed: 5 December 1929"; "In December 1929, Tajik ASSR was detached from the Uzbek SSR and given full status", and the capital is renamed Stalinabad.
1991, 31 August: "Renamed to the Republic of Tajikistan: 31 August 1991" (sovereignty declared 24 August 1990).

certainty.note: The page lists no districts of the autonomous republic.
Union-republic borders; the page is silent on dated changes with Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan.
